messages:
emma: Hey team — I addressed the PR comments on https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234 and pushed updates. PTAL when you have a minute. Short summary: fixed allocator nil-ptr, added unit that reproduces the rotation edge-case, tightened a couple of logs, and added a changelog entry. Planning to merge during the canary window tomorrow ~11:00 PDT unless someone objects. @sachin @alex
ci-bot: CI report: linux jobs ✅, macOS job flaky (timeout). Suggestion: rerun macOS job with `/retest-macos`

sachin: skimmed — LGTM overall. left one tiny nit about the log wording (see inline). Also can you squash the two allocator commits into one?

emma: @sachin good call — will squash. For the log nit I changed it to "kv-alloc rotate" to keep it short. PTAL on that diff when you get a sec.

alex: quick question — does this touch KV cache eviction semantics under memory pressure? want to be sure we don't regress tail latency on busy hosts.

emma: No functional change to eviction policy — this only fixes rotation race in allocator allocation path. I added a unit test that exercises eviction-ish timing (kvcache/allocator_test.go lines 42-68). Paste of the small repro snippet I used:
```
// simplified repro
allocator.Allocate(ctx, 512)
// force rotation while background flush running
```

linda: PTAL from me too — tiny style nit on the test helper, otherwise :thumbsup:

sachin: once you squash I'll approve. small nit doesn't block.

emma: Squashed and pushed to branch `fix/allocator-rotation-squash`. Triggered a macOS rerun: `/retest-macos`

ci-bot: macOS job passed on rerun ✅

alex: Approved. One small ask: could you add a single-line changelog under Unreleased -> Runtime describing the allocator rotation fix? helps ops correlate with release notes.

emma: Added changelog entry and pushed. Scheduling merge ops for tomorrow 11:05 PDT to line up with canary rollout. If anyone needs a different time say now.

rajesh: I can handle the merge ops and smoke-checks after merge. ping me when you merge and I'll run the `smoke/runtime` job.

emma: Awesome — thanks @rajesh. Unless I hear objections I'll merge during the window; PTAL final time please. :slightly_smiling_face:
